description.fun: Skrelp is a poor swimmer that gets swept away by storms, so it rides drifting seaweed across the ocean and disguises itself as a bit of kelp while it saves up energy to evolve. Anything that comes close gets sprayed with poison, which it brews from the rotten seaweed it eats. Its sickly colours may be a comment on water pollution.
description.guide: Skrelp is a Poison- and Water-type Pokémon from Kalos based on the weedy seadragon. It hides among floating seaweed and sprays poison at anything that approaches, making its venom from the rotten seaweed it eats. It evolves into Dragalge.
description.tagline: A scrap of rotten kelp that's really a poisonous sea dragon

description.fun: Dragalge's poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a metal tanker, which is why ships that sail into its waters are said never to come back. It guards its territory fiercely, ambushing prey from a hiding place among the seaweed, and it makes dragon energy by soaking up sunlight through the plume on its head. Oddly, it gets along well with Dhelmise.
description.guide: Dragalge is a Poison- and Dragon-type Pokémon that evolves from Skrelp, based on the leafy seadragon. It hides in seaweed and sprays a poison that can corrode metal ships at anything entering its territory. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Dragalge, introduced in Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: A seaweed dragon whose poison melts ships

description.fun: Mega Dragalge, from Pokémon Legends: Z-A, grows a flowing cape of six kelp fronds and antler-like antennae with glowing orbs. It oozes a liquid that sends cell regeneration into overdrive, healing itself while poisoning every other living thing, and has the highest Special Defense of any Mega.
